New Game — Legendary Battlefield [Preview] 🏆

Qualifiers — Legendary Trials are now open! All
eligible Lords can participate and compete on the
battlefield for group rankings.

will advance to the King, Elite, or Rising Star Group.

Ultimately, 1,200 Lords will qualify for the Legendary
Battlefield Main Tournament!

Are you ready to write your own legend?

Please click the link to view the detailed gameplay
instructions!
